title: Cross-cutting MCP protocol, client, SDK and provider limits
description: data-pack/limits/cross-cutting.json — the limits that belong to the MCP protocol, a host/client, an SDK default or a provider account rather than to any one model. Written for RM-38 WP 1.1; the file predates its schema, so this describes the structure the compatibility engine actually reads and leaves the hand-curated leaves open (additionalProperties: true) rather than pretending to a completeness it never had.

mcp_protocol.description: Ceilings the MCP specification itself sets (mostly: none — which is the finding).

clients.description: Per-host tool-count and timeout caps. `cross.clients.<id>.max_tools` is read by the compatibility engine, so its type is pinned; everything else stays open.

sdk_defaults.description: Defaults an SDK applies when the caller sets nothing.

serving_stack_open_weight.description: What binds when you serve open weights yourself (operator-configured, not vendor-fixed).

providers.description: Account-level and API-level limits that are not per model: cache breakpoints, rate-limit meters, schema micro-limits.
